pairs.title: A gate's verdict: a silent pass → three named states
pairs.caption: Before: the check as it was, an unreachable commit fell through to fresh. After: three verdicts named by their exit code, the removed silent pass kept in the picture as a note, drawn top-down for a phone.

before.label: the check as it was

after.label: the check now, third draft: verdicts named by exit code
after.source:
---
title: The graph-freshness check, three verdicts, no silent pass
---
stateDiagram-v2
  direction TB
  state "read the built-from commit" as Resolve
  state "count commits since it" as Count
  state "Unknown, exit 3" as Unknown
  state "Stale, exit 2" as Stale
  state "Fresh, exit 0" as Fresh
  [*] --> Resolve
  Resolve --> Unknown: commit unreachable
  Resolve --> Count: commit found
  Count --> Stale: over 50 commits or 30 days
  Count --> Fresh: within both
  note left of Unknown
    was: unreachable fell through to Fresh, silently
  end note
  Unknown --> [*]
  Stale --> [*]
  Fresh --> [*]
  classDef new stroke-width:3px
  class Unknown new

pairs.title: A plan issue as a context store: a comment thread → one state block
pairs.caption: Before: seven comments a pickup session had to read or guess from. After: the done slices folded into one state, the slice in flight opened into its steps, and the one gate a human holds drawn dashed, so the ask is visible without reading.

after.label: the state block, third draft: the current slice opened, the human gate dashed
after.source:
---
title: "Plan #3769 on 2026-09-26, where it stood"
---
stateDiagram-v2
  direction TB
  state "Done: slices 1 to 4 and 6" as Done
  state "5: the bash guard, a rank-1 gate" as S5 {
    state "the script, #3781 merged" as script
    state "the wiring, boards platter #3783" as wiring
    script --> wiring
  }
  state "waiting on Eric: merge platter #3783" as Wait
  [*] --> Done
  Done --> S5: next pickup
  S5 --> Wait: the wiring is a protected file
  Wait --> [*]: his click closes the plan
  classDef current stroke-width:3px
  classDef human stroke-dasharray:6 4
  class S5 current
  class Wait human
